world.title: United States Mint Director Paul Hollis to Participate in the American Numismatic Association’s 2026 World's Fair of Money® Pittsburgh
world.description: WASHINGTON, D.C., Aug. 18, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) -- United States Mint (Mint) Director Paul Hollis will participate in the official ribbon-cutting ceremony for the American Numismatic Association’s (ANA) World’s Fair of Money at the David L. Lawrence Convention Center in Pittsburgh (1000 Fort Duquesne Blvd., Pittsburgh, PA 15222). The ribbon-cutting will occur in Lobby B on Tuesday, August 25 at noon EDT. Attendees will also have an opportunity to meet with Director Hollis while visiting the Mint booth #830. Additionally, Director Hollis will give a presentation to young numismatists on Saturday, August 29, during the ANA Young Collectors Corner Program in Room 327. The Fair runs from August 25 to 29, 2025, with free admission to the public on Saturday, August 29.
